description: Modernize the three news pages to match the homepage's modern fintech feel while keeping the Ink & Oxblood base + electric-blue accent. This covers the news listing (app/(site)/news/page.tsx), the article detail page (app/(site)/news/[slug]/page.tsx), and the category landing page (app/(site)/news/category/[category]/page.tsx). Reuse the existing ArticleCard, CategoryBadge, and Reveal components. This is one coherent feature because all three pages share the same lead-story + card-grid + category-filter structure.
steps: news/page.tsx (listing): Wrap the page header in <Reveal className="section-header mb-8"> keeping .eyebrow-accent 'Newsroom' + .page-title 'News'. Modernize the category filter row: keep it accessible (nav with aria-label, aria-current on the active 'All' link) but restyle tabs as accent-tinted pill/underline tabs using the electric-blue accent for the active state (active: text-accent/border-accent; inactive: text-ink-muted hover:text-accent) instead of oxblood; keep the hairline underline row. Give the lead/featured story a stronger modern treatment: real image with a subtle hover zoom (group-hover:scale-105 motion-reduce:transform-none like ArticleCard), accent CategoryBadge, .title-link headline, byline with author + date + reading time. Wrap the lead story and the ArticleCard grid in <Reveal> (stagger the grid via per-item delay={i*0.05} by mapping with index). Keep the empty-state panel. Preserve the exported `metadata` object and all data fetching (getAllArticles, getCategories) unchanged.

news/[slug]/page.tsx (article detail): Keep generateMetadata, Open Graph, Twitter, and the Article JSON-LD (generateArticleSchema) wiring EXACTLY as-is. Modernize the visual layer: give the hero image a stronger presentation (rounded-2xl overflow-hidden frame consistent with the design system, keep priority + sizes + fill). Refine the author byline block into a modern row with the rounded-full avatar, author name, date, and reading time, using accent hover on the breadcrumb links (hover:text-accent dark:hover:text-accent-light) instead of oxblood. Modernize the author bio aside into an elevated card (rounded-2xl border border-hairline bg-surface p-6 dark:border-hairline-dark dark:bg-elevated) keeping the rounded-full avatar. Modernize 'Related Articles' as a Reveal-wrapped card grid reusing ArticleCard (keep the rule-grid or switch to the same staggered grid; ArticleCard already handles hover). Do NOT change article body rendering (PortableTextRenderer) or the data fetching.

news/category/[category]/page.tsx (category landing): Apply the same modernization as the listing page: accent category-filter tabs with the active category highlighted in accent (keep aria-current), accent-hover breadcrumb links, modern lead story with hover-zoom image + .title-link, and a Reveal-staggered ArticleCard grid. Keep generateMetadata, the categoryMeta map, and all data fetching (getArticlesByCategory, getCategories) unchanged.

Ensure every hover/transform animation includes a motion-reduce: guard where it animates transforms, and that Reveal wraps section headers and card grids. Use text-accent/accent-light and hover:border-accent/40 for accent; do not introduce oxblood as the primary interactive accent on these pages (oxblood remains only where the shared CategoryBadge/category tones already use it).
acceptance_criteria: All three news pages render the category filter with the active tab highlighted using the electric-blue accent, and breadcrumb/nav links hover to the accent color.
The lead story image zooms on hover with a motion-reduce:transform-none guard, and headlines use .title-link.
Card grids and section headers are wrapped in <Reveal> with per-item stagger on the grids.
The Article JSON-LD, generateMetadata, Open Graph, and Twitter metadata on news/[slug]/page.tsx are byte-for-byte preserved in behavior (same schema fields and values).
Data fetching calls (getAllArticles, getCategories, getArticleBySlug, getRelatedArticles, getArticlesByCategory) are unchanged.
`npm run lint` and `npm run build` both pass.
verification: Confirm the Article JSON-LD script tag still renders generateArticleSchema output on news/[slug]/page.tsx (grep for generateArticleSchema and application/ld+json).
findings: Modernized all three news pages (news/page.tsx, news/[slug]/page.tsx, news/category/[category]/page.tsx). Category-filter tabs now use the electric-blue accent for active (border-b-2 border-accent + text-accent) and hover:text-accent for inactive, replacing oxblood; kept nav aria-label and aria-current. Lead story image gets rounded-2xl frame + group-hover:scale-105 with motion-reduce:transform-none guard. Section headers wrapped in <Reveal>; lead story wrapped in <Reveal>; ArticleCard grids wrapped per-item in <Reveal delay={i*0.05}> for stagger. Article page: breadcrumb links now hover to accent, hero image gets rounded-2xl frame + hairline border, author bio aside converted to elevated modern card (rounded-2xl border border-hairline bg-surface p-6 dark:border-hairline-dark dark:bg-elevated), Related Articles header Reveal-wrapped and grid staggered. SEO fully preserved: generateMetadata, openGraph, twitter, and generateArticleSchema JSON-LD (type=application/ld+json) untouched (verified via grep). No changes to data fetching (getAllArticles, getCategories, getArticleBySlug, getRelatedArticles, getArticlesByCategory) or PortableTextRenderer. Reused ArticleCard/CategoryBadge/Reveal as-is; no new components or one-off styles. Note: rounded-2xl renders at 2px per the clamped borderRadius scale but is used consistently with the design system; the modern feel comes from hover lift/zoom, accent color, and Reveal. `npm run lint` (No ESLint warnings or errors) and `npm run build` both pass.
